positive.description: Create, read, and summarize a Markdown document. Prerequisite: the reviewer is connected to Strata with an account that can create personal documents. This case creates its own synthetic fixture and has no dependency on another case. Generate a fresh eight-character suffix for the title and keep the returned document ID. Run only against that new document.
positive.prompt:
Create a private personal Strata document titled "Strata review plan" with a fresh eight-character suffix. Use this exact content:

# Community workshop

## Plan
- Maya prepares the slides by November 10.
- Leo books the room by November 12.
- The workshop is on November 20.

## Budget
The total budget is $600.

Then read the saved document and summarize the owners, deadlines, event date, and budget. Include the saved document title and ID so I can find it.
positive.expected_behavior: create_document receives the unique title and supplied Markdown in content, with folderId omitted for the owner-only personal root. It returns a new document ID. read_document uses that exact returned ID. Its saved content contains the two headings, both owners and deadlines, the November 20 event date, and the $600 budget. The response includes the actual returned ID and title and accurately summarizes Maya/slides/November 10, Leo/room/November 12, workshop/November 20, and budget/$600. It does not invent additional commitments. A creation or read error must be reported and cannot count as a pass.

positive.description: Search for a newly created synthetic document, then verify the result by reading it. Prerequisite: a connected reviewer account with personal-document creation and search access. Generate a fresh eight-character suffix; use it in both the title and body. Retain the ID returned by creation. This case is independent of all other cases. Allow up to three search attempts over 60 seconds for indexing; if still absent, record the search case as failed or blocked, not passed.
positive.prompt: Create a private personal Strata document titled "Strata search review" with a fresh eight-character suffix. Its body should say "Violet observatory: the sample telescope reservation is for November 18." and include that same suffix. Then search my Strata documents using the complete new title, show the matching search result, and read it back to confirm the reservation date. If it has not appeared in search yet, retry at most three times over one minute and tell me if it is still unavailable; do not claim that creation alone proves search worked.
positive.expected_behavior: create_document saves the unique title and synthetic text with folderId omitted. find uses intent="search", scope={"type":"all"}, and query equal to the complete generated title. At least one actual returned item must have the newly created document ID and matching title; older similarly titled documents do not qualify. read_document uses that matching ID and returns the November 18 reservation text and suffix. The final answer identifies the real search hit and reservation date. Eventual indexing may require the bounded retries described in setup. If no matching item is returned, explain that search is unverified and do not fabricate a search result or mark the case passed.

positive.description: Make one exact text replacement and verify persistence without altering unrelated text. Prerequisite: a connected reviewer account with personal-document creation and editing access. Create the fixture in this prompt with a fresh eight-character title suffix; use only its returned ID throughout. No previous case or existing document is required.
positive.prompt:
Create a private personal Strata document titled "Strata edit review" with a fresh eight-character suffix and this exact content:

# Launch checklist

The launch date is November 15.

The support owner is Jordan.

Read the saved document, change only "The launch date is November 15." to "The launch date is November 22.", then read it again to verify the change and confirm the support owner stayed the same. Include the document ID.
positive.expected_behavior: create_document uses the supplied Markdown and omits folderId. read_document fetches the returned ID before editing. replace_document_text uses the same documentId, oldString="The launch date is November 15.", newString="The launch date is November 22.", and replaceAll omitted or false. A second read_document confirms the November 22 sentence is present, the November 15 sentence is absent, and the heading plus "The support owner is Jordan." remain unchanged. Report the actual ID and verified change; do not claim success if replacement or readback fails.

positive.description: Add a comment to a new document and verify it appears in that document’s comment list. Prerequisite: a connected reviewer account with personal-document creation and comment access. Use the self-contained synthetic fixture and a fresh eight-character title suffix. Use only its returned ID. The comment has no @mentions and must not invoke another agent or notify an external recipient.
positive.prompt:
Create a private personal Strata document titled "Strata comment review" with a fresh eight-character suffix and this content:

# Workshop review

The registration form is ready.

Read it, then add this comment to that document: "Please add an accessibility checklist before launch." Do not mention anyone. Show the document’s comment list afterward to confirm the comment was saved, and give me the document ID and saved comment ID.
positive.expected_behavior: create_document saves the supplied content with folderId omitted. read_document fetches the new ID. create_comment uses that same documentId and body="Please add an accessibility checklist before launch." with parentCommentId omitted, and contains no @mention. It returns a saved comment/thread identifier. list_comments uses the same documentId with status omitted or "active" and returns the new comment text and identifier. The answer cites the actual document and comment identifiers and confirms persistence only from these responses. It does not edit the document body or start an agent task. Missing or failed comment readback is not a pass.

positive.description: Create a simple presentation and export audience-facing standalone HTML with presenter notes removed. Prerequisite: a connected reviewer account that can create personal documents and use HTML presentation export. HTML export is unmetered; do not request paid PDF capture. This case creates its own deck using a fresh eight-character title suffix. The reviewer must open the returned URL before its expiry and inspect the downloaded HTML and rendered deck to complete the pass check.
positive.prompt:
Create a private personal Strata document titled "Strata presentation review" with a fresh eight-character suffix, using the following exact Markdown. Read it back, export it as a standalone HTML presentation for the audience, and give me the download link and expiry time. Keep presenter notes out of the export.

---
presentation:
  aspect: "16:9"
---
# Sample workshop

## Checklist
```slide layout="bullets"
- Room reserved
- Slides prepared
```

Presenter note: REVIEW-NOTE-PRIVATE-7429. This text is for the speaker only.
positive.expected_behavior: create_document receives the unique title and exact presentation Markdown with folderId omitted. read_document uses its returned ID and confirms frontmatter, headings, bullet slide fence, and presenter-note marker. export_presentation uses the same documentId, format="presentationHtml", and revision omitted for the live document. The response must contain a nonempty HTTPS url, positive bytes, and a parseable expiresAt later than the export time. The assistant returns the actual URL and expiry without claiming unperformed inspection. To pass, the reviewer opens that URL before expiry and confirms the HTML renders the Sample workshop cover and Checklist slide with both bullets, and that REVIEW-NOTE-PRIVATE-7429 and the speaker-only sentence are absent from the exported HTML. A tool response alone does not establish the visual or note-removal checks. Report any export or download failure; never substitute a fabricated URL.

negative.description: Account security is outside the Strata document-tool surface. No fixture is needed. Expected: explain that the Strata plugin cannot change an account password and direct the user to the service’s account settings or official support without inventing a settings URL. Do not call any Strata tool, solicit a password, or claim a password was changed.
negative.prompt: Change the password on my Strata account for me.

negative.description: Subscription management is outside the Strata document-tool surface. No fixture is needed. Expected: explain that the Strata plugin cannot change a subscription and direct the user to Strata billing settings or official support. Do not call any Strata tool, ask for card details, or claim an upgrade or charge occurred.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Strata subscription to the next paid plan.

negative.description: Strata’s exposed tools do not configure automatic recurring backups. No fixture is needed. Expected: explain this limitation and, if useful, describe manual alternatives without performing them. Do not invoke any Strata tool, create a document as a substitute for a backup schedule, or claim the recurring backup is active. Any independent host scheduling capability is outside this case; this prompt requests a setting in Strata itself.
negative.prompt: Set Strata itself to back up all my documents automatically every night at midnight. I want this enabled in Strata, not a reminder.
